title: 七步洗手法
nativeSvg:
<svg data-theme="pastel" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1200 1600" width="1200" height="1600">
<title>七步洗手法</title>
<g data-md-layer="挂图">
<rect width="1200" height="1600" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
<text id="title" x="80" y="140" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="76" fill="#3A3A48" font-weight="900">七步洗手法</text>
<text x="84" y="196" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="26" fill="#6A6A7A" font-weight="500">大班健康课</text>
<rect x="80" y="260" width="500" height="270" rx="36" fill="#FBD6C6"/>
<circle cx="170" cy="360" r="62" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
<text x="170" y="386" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="72" fill="#C9583A" font-weight="900" text-anchor="middle">内</text>
<text x="260" y="342" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="22" fill="#C9583A" font-weight="700">第 1 步</text>
<text x="120" y="466" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#3A3A48" font-weight="500">掌心相对，手指并拢，</text>
<text x="120" y="502" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#3A3A48" font-weight="500">相互揉搓</text>
<circle cx="510" cy="330" r="8" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.8"/>
<circle cx="484" cy="340" r="6" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.8"/>
<circle cx="458" cy="350" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.8"/>
<rect x="610" y="260" width="500" height="270" rx="36" fill="#CFEBDD"/>
<circle cx="700" cy="360" r="62" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
<text x="700" y="386" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="72" fill="#2F8A5C" font-weight="900" text-anchor="middle">外</text>
<text x="790" y="342" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="22" fill="#2F8A5C" font-weight="700">第 2 步</text>
<text x="650" y="466" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#3A3A48" font-weight="500">手心对手背，沿指缝</text>
<text x="650" y="502" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#3A3A48" font-weight="500">相互揉搓，交换进行</text>
<circle cx="1040" cy="330" r="8" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.8"/>
<circle cx="1014" cy="340" r="6" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.8"/>
<circle cx="988" cy="350" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.8"/>
<rect x="80" y="560" width="500" height="270" rx="36" fill="#CFE2F6"/>
<circle cx="170" cy="660" r="62" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
<text x="170" y="686" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="72" fill="#2F6BA8" font-weight="900" text-anchor="middle">夹</text>
<text x="260" y="642" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="22" fill="#2F6BA8" font-weight="700">第 3 步</text>
<text x="120" y="766" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#3A3A48" font-weight="500">掌心相对，双手交叉，</text>
<text x="120" y="802" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#3A3A48" font-weight="500">沿指缝相互揉搓</text>
<circle cx="510" cy="630" r="8" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.8"/>
<circle cx="484" cy="640" r="6" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.8"/>
<circle cx="458" cy="650" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.8"/>
<rect x="610" y="560" width="500" height="270" rx="36" fill="#FBEFB8"/>
<circle cx="700" cy="660" r="62" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
<text x="700" y="686" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="72" fill="#A88A12" font-weight="900" text-anchor="middle">弓</text>
<text x="790" y="642" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="22" fill="#A88A12" font-weight="700">第 4 步</text>
<text x="650" y="766" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#3A3A48" font-weight="500">弯曲手指，指关节在另一手</text>
<text x="650" y="802" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#3A3A48" font-weight="500">掌心旋转揉搓，交换进行</text>
<circle cx="1040" cy="630" r="8" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.8"/>
<circle cx="1014" cy="640" r="6" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.8"/>
<circle cx="988" cy="650" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.8"/>
<rect x="80" y="860" width="500" height="270" rx="36" fill="#E3D8F3"/>
<circle cx="170" cy="960" r="62" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
<text x="170" y="986" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="72" fill="#6E4FA8" font-weight="900" text-anchor="middle">大</text>
<text x="260" y="942" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="22" fill="#6E4FA8" font-weight="700">第 5 步</text>
<text x="120" y="1066" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#3A3A48" font-weight="500">一手握住另一手的大拇指</text>
<text x="120" y="1102" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#3A3A48" font-weight="500">旋转揉搓，交换进行</text>
<circle cx="510" cy="930" r="8" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.8"/>
<circle cx="484" cy="940" r="6" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.8"/>
<circle cx="458" cy="950" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.8"/>
<rect x="610" y="860" width="500" height="270" rx="36" fill="#F8D3E1"/>
<circle cx="700" cy="960" r="62" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
<text x="700" y="986" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="72" fill="#B8456E" font-weight="900" text-anchor="middle">立</text>
<text x="790" y="942" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="22" fill="#B8456E" font-weight="700">第 6 步</text>
<text x="650" y="1066" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#3A3A48" font-weight="500">五个指尖并拢，在另一手</text>
<text x="650" y="1102" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#3A3A48" font-weight="500">掌心旋转揉搓，交换进行</text>
<circle cx="1040" cy="930" r="8" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.8"/>
<circle cx="1014" cy="940" r="6" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.8"/>
<circle cx="988" cy="950" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.8"/>
<rect x="80" y="1160" width="500" height="270" rx="36" fill="#EEDFCB"/>
<circle cx="170" cy="1260" r="62" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
<text x="170" y="1286" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="72" fill="#8A6A3C" font-weight="900" text-anchor="middle">腕</text>
<text x="260" y="1242" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="22" fill="#8A6A3C" font-weight="700">第 7 步</text>
<text x="120" y="1366" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#3A3A48" font-weight="500">揉搓手腕，</text>
<text x="120" y="1402" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#3A3A48" font-weight="500">交换进行</text>
<circle cx="510" cy="1230" r="8" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.8"/>
<circle cx="484" cy="1240" r="6" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.8"/>
<circle cx="458" cy="1250" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.8"/>
<rect x="610" y="1160" width="500" height="270" rx="36" fill="#F3F4F7"/>
<text x="650" y="1230" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="26" fill="#6A6A7A" font-weight="700">口诀</text>
<text x="650" y="1290" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="38" fill="#3A3A48" font-weight="900">内 外 夹 弓 大 立 腕</text>
<text x="650" y="1350" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#3A3A48" font-weight="500">整个过程至少 20 秒，</text>
<text x="650" y="1386" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#3A3A48" font-weight="500">大约是唱两遍《生日快乐歌》。</text>
<text x="80" y="1520" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#6A6A7A" font-weight="500">先用流动的水打湿双手，抹上洗手液，按七步揉搓后冲干净。</text>
</g>
</svg>
